# Structured Evidence Fixture Rules

These fixtures must stay synthetic. They may model table shapes, profile
shapes, career-entry shapes, OCR noise patterns, and review failure classes, but
they must not copy WFRP book text, screenshots, table contents, stat blocks, or
PDF-derived page crops. Do not copy private sourcebook material into this
directory.

Use short invented names such as "Synthetic Road Wardens" and "Synthetic City"
when a test needs domain-like labels. If a private local fixture pack is needed
later, keep it ignored under the local data directory and reference only counts,
hashes, or shape metadata from committed tests.
